build.beforeDevCommand: pnpm run assets:sync && pnpm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm run assets:sync && pnpm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self' tauri: asset:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob: mediastream:; worker-src 'self' blob:; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
